name: io.github.n24q02m/wet
description: Open-source MCP server for AI agents: web search, content extraction, and library docs.

environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key — the single default credential for the [models.embed|rerank|chat|jev_score] provider cells and the openrouter search backend. Per-task overrides live in ~/.wet/config.toml; keys may also be injected via HULL_EMBED_API_KEY / HULL_RERANK_API_KEY / HULL_CHAT_API_KEY / HULL_JEV_SCORE_API_KEY. Empty cells fall back to local ONNX models.
environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: GitHub personal access token for higher rate limits on library discovery
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
